title: Engineering Drawing Ballooning Pattern Library – extracted from supplied drawing set
purpose: Pattern families and notation variants to drive pre-detection/highlighting before AutoDetect ballooning.

coverage.note: The supplied drawings ZIP contains 102 PDF drawings. Numeric values are instances; the library stores normalized characteristic families so new values can match the same family.

critical_rules: Search the entire selected ROI against every pattern family; do not stop after the first match.
A quantity modifier such as 2x/4x belongs to the following feature; do not create a separate balloon for the multiplier.
TYP, THRU, THRU ALL, DEEP/DEPTH, and FROM OTHER SIDE are modifiers that should be clustered with the parent feature.
Do not use title-block notes such as REV, DATE, SCALE, MATERIAL, DRAWING NO, etc. as characteristics.
Do not rely on OCR text alone for GD&T, datum frames, surface-finish symbols, or other graphical symbols.
Support PDF text layer first and OCR fallback second; merge/deduplicate detections spatially.
Normalize Ø/∅/Φ and OCR confusions O/Q/0 only in the matching layer; preserve the original drawing text for display.
Normalize decimal comma and decimal point equivalently for matching.
Support rotated/vertical text and stacked tolerance layouts.
Keep coordinates in the PDF/page coordinate system so highlights can be drawn immediately after ROI selection.
Return all matches with confidence and bounding boxes; do not silently discard low-confidence candidates. Use a review state when confidence is insufficient.

patterns.name: Linear dimension
match_rules: numeric dimension token
allow decimal point or decimal comma
allow optional unit text

patterns.name: Bilateral tolerance
match_rules: allow spaces/no spaces around ±
allow decimal comma

patterns.name: Unilateral positive tolerance
match_rules: allow stacked OCR tolerance lines

patterns.name: Unilateral negative tolerance
match_rules: allow Unicode minus

patterns.name: Asymmetric plus/minus tolerance
match_rules: accept split stacked OCR representation

patterns.name: Diameter
match_rules: accept Ø, ∅, Φ, phi and OCR O/Q/0 normalization when followed by a number

patterns.name: Diameter with fit/tolerance
match_rules: associate adjacent fit/tolerance text with same callout

patterns.name: Radius
match_rules: allow R <number> spacing
allow optional tolerance

patterns.name: Angle
match_rules: allow decimal angle and optional angular tolerance

patterns.name: Chamfer
match_rules: allow x/X/×
allow optional degree symbol

patterns.name: Chamfer marked TYP
match_rules: TYP is a modifier, not a separate balloon unless the UI treats it as part of the callout

patterns.name: Repeated feature quantity
match_rules: quantity belongs to the following feature; do not balloon count separately

patterns.name: Through hole
match_rules: associate THRU with preceding diameter/hole size

patterns.name: Through-all hole
match_rules: THRU ALL is part of same characteristic

patterns.name: Thread
match_rules: accept decimal pitch only when present
do not confuse material/part numbers with M notation

patterns.name: Thread with pitch
match_rules: allow x/X/× and spacing

patterns.name: Thread through all
match_rules: THRU ALL is attached modifier

patterns.name: Thread through
match_rules: THRU is attached modifier

patterns.name: Fit designation
match_rules: common fit letters include H/h, G/g, D/d, C/c, F/f, E/e, J/j, M/m, B/b, etc.; preserve exact case when meaningful

patterns.name: Depth
match_rules: associate depth modifier with preceding hole/feature

patterns.name: Typical modifier
match_rules: TYP modifies a feature and must stay attached to its parent characteristic

patterns.name: From-other-side modifier
match_rules: attach to the nearby hole/feature callout

patterns.name: Datum reference
match_rules: recognize datum flag/reference geometry separately from ordinary text

patterns.name: Geometric tolerance / feature-control-frame text
match_rules: detect the complete feature-control frame and associated datum letters; visual symbol may not survive text extraction

patterns.name: Surface-finish characteristic
observed_forms: surface-finish symbols are present visually in the supplied drawings
match_rules: requires visual/vector symbol detection; OCR text alone is insufficient

patterns.name: Stacked/multiline characteristic
patterns.canonical: <VALUE> on one line + <TOLERANCE/FIT/DEPTH> on adjacent line
match_rules: cluster by spatial proximity and leader-line context before classification

patterns.name: Decimal comma variant
match_rules: normalize comma to dot internally but preserve original display text
